DriverAI | Internal / Recruiting Use

1. Role Purpose (Position Summary)
The Data Engineer designs, builds, maintains, and improves the data pipelines, data integrations, cloud data services, and structured data environments that support DriverAI's analytics, reporting, dashboards, machine learning, computer vision, product intelligence, and business decision-making functions.
This role supports the Data Analytics team by ensuring reliable access to clean, organized, timely, and usable data from multiple sources, including application systems, cloud services, databases, APIs, logs, telemetry, product usage data, image/video metadata, business systems, and Amazon Web Services (AWS) infrastructure.
The Data Engineer works closely with data analysts, cloud engineers, software developers, AI/ML engineers, cybersecurity personnel, and leadership to ensure data is collected, processed, stored, secured, documented, and delivered in a way that supports operational visibility and strategic decisions.
2. Essential Duties and Responsibilities
A. Data Pipeline Development and Automation
Develop, maintain, and improve data pipelines that ingest, transform, validate, and deliver data for analytics, dashboards, reporting, machine learning, and business intelligence.
Build automated Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) and Extract, Load, Transform (ELT) workflows from internal systems, external sources, APIs, databases, cloud storage, application logs, telemetry streams, and other approved data sources.
Create repeatable data processing workflows using Python, SQL, scripting, orchestration tools, and cloud-native services.
Support batch, scheduled, near-real-time, and real-time data movement depending on business, product, and analytics requirements.
Automate recurring data collection, cleansing, validation, reporting, and monitoring processes to reduce manual effort and improve data reliability.
Work with analysts to convert recurring manual reports into scalable, automated, and documented data pipelines.
B. AWS Data Infrastructure Support
Interface with AWS infrastructure to support secure, scalable, and efficient data collection, storage, processing, and delivery.
Work with AWS services such as Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3), Amazon Relational Database Service (RDS), Amazon Redshift, Amazon Glue, Amazon Athena, AWS Lambda, Amazon CloudWatch, Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), Amazon Elastic Container Service (ECS), Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), Amazon API Gateway, Amazon DynamoDB, and Amazon QuickSight, as applicable.
Support data movement between AWS storage, databases, analytics tools, dashboards, application services, and internal reporting environments.
Collaborate with AWS engineers and cloud administrators to ensure data workflows align with approved architecture, access control, logging, encryption, backup, monitoring, and cost-management requirements.
Assist with cloud data resource monitoring, performance tuning, troubleshooting, and cost optimization.
Support environment separation for development, testing, staging, and production data workflows when applicable.
C. Data Modeling, Database, and Storage Design
Design and maintain data models, schemas, tables, views, metadata structures, and curated datasets that support analytics and reporting needs.
Develop and optimize SQL queries, stored procedures, database views, and data transformations.
Support relational, NoSQL, object storage, data lake, data warehouse, and analytics-ready data structures.
Organize raw, cleaned, curated, and production-ready datasets using clear naming conventions, lifecycle controls, and documentation standards.
Support database performance, indexing, partitioning, query optimization, and data access efficiency.
Help define standards for structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data used across analytics, AI/ML, product, and operational systems.
D. Data Quality, Validation, and Reliability
Implement data quality controls, validation checks, anomaly detection rules, reconciliation processes, and automated alerts.
Identify and resolve issues involving missing data, duplicate records, inconsistent fields, broken pipelines, incorrect transformations, schema drift, and unreliable source data.
Develop monitoring routines that confirm data pipelines run successfully and deliver complete, accurate, and timely outputs.
Document data assumptions, transformation logic, known limitations, source-system dependencies, and quality concerns.
Work with the Data Analytics team to ensure dashboards, metrics, key performance indicators, and reports are based on trusted and validated data.
Support root-cause analysis when reports, dashboards, or analytics outputs show inconsistent or unexpected results.
E. Analytics, Dashboard, and KPI Enablement
Support the Data Analytics team by preparing datasets, tables, views, and pipelines required for dashboards, metrics, operational reporting, and executive decision-making.
Work with analysts to understand reporting requirements, business definitions, key performance indicators (KPIs), and data dependencies.
Prepare analytics-ready datasets for tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Grafana, Amazon QuickSight, Metabase, or similar platforms.
Support real-time or near-real-time data feedback loops for product usage, application performance, operational trends, customer behavior, AI/ML outputs, and business performance.
Help ensure dashboard data is refreshed, validated, traceable, and aligned with agreed definitions.
Assist in developing data products that improve visibility, accountability, operational decision-making, and leadership reporting.
F. API, Application, and Product Data Integration
Build and maintain data integrations with internal applications, third-party tools, web services, APIs, databases, mobile applications, cloud platforms, and business systems.
Support event tracking, telemetry collection, product analytics, and operational data flows from mobile, web, backend, and AI-enabled systems.
Work with software developers to define data contracts, event schemas, API payloads, logging standards, and application-generated data requirements.
Support integration of computer vision, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and product recognition outputs into analytics and reporting workflows.
Assist with ingestion and organization of metadata associated with images, videos, model outputs, product recognition results, user activity, indoor mapping data, location events, and system performance data.
G. Security, Governance, Privacy, and Compliance Support
Follow secure data engineering practices, including least-privilege access, role-based access control, encryption, logging, data minimization, and secure handling of company, customer, and user data.
Coordinate with cybersecurity, cloud, and governance teams to align data workflows with applicable security, privacy, and compliance requirements.
Support documentation and evidence collection for governance, audit readiness, cybersecurity reporting, SOC 2, Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) Level 2, National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)-aligned controls, or other applicable requirements when needed.
Help maintain data lineage, data dictionaries, access documentation, pipeline documentation, and data-handling procedures.
Support data retention, data lifecycle, backup, recovery, and controlled access practices.
Escalate data security risks, unauthorized access concerns, sensitive-data exposure risks, or control gaps to the appropriate leadership or security personnel.
H. Collaboration, Documentation, and Cross-Functional Support
Collaborate with Data Analytics, AWS infrastructure, software development, AI/ML, computer vision, cybersecurity, product, operations, and leadership teams.
Participate in sprint planning, technical reviews, data requirements discussions, architecture reviews, issue tracking, and project status meetings.
Maintain documentation for data sources, schemas, data flows, pipelines, transformations, job schedules, dependencies, access controls, and troubleshooting procedures.
Use Git, GitHub, GitLab, Jira, SharePoint, Microsoft 365, or similar tools to support version control, collaboration, issue management, and documentation.
Support other technical duties as assigned in a cross-disciplinary startup environment.
3. Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Data Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Software Engineering, Cloud Computing, Analytics, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or a related technical field; equivalent practical experience may be considered.
Practical experience building data pipelines, data integrations, automated data workflows, or database-supported analytics systems.
Strong SQL skills, including query development, joins, views, aggregation, data validation, and performance-aware query design.
Experience with Python or another scripting language used for data processing, automation, application programming interface integration, or workflow development.
Understanding of ETL/ELT concepts, data pipeline architecture, data modeling, data quality, and analytics enablement.
Working knowledge of cloud environments, preferably AWS.
Experience working with relational databases, cloud databases, data warehouses, data lakes, object storage, or NoSQL databases.
Ability to troubleshoot pipeline failures, data issues, query problems, access issues, and integration errors.
Strong documentation skills and ability to communicate technical information clearly to analysts, developers, engineers, and leadership.
Ability to work independently on assigned tasks while coordinating with technical leads, project managers, and cross-functional teams.
4. Preferred Qualifications
Experience with AWS data services such as S3, Glue, Athena, Redshift, RDS, DynamoDB, Lambda, CloudWatch, QuickSight, EC2, ECS, EKS, or API Gateway.
Experience with data orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, AWS Step Functions, or similar workflow tools.
Experience with data transformation tools such as dbt, AWS Glue, Spark, PySpark, Pandas, or similar technologies.
Experience with data visualization and business intelligence tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Grafana, Amazon QuickSight, Metabase, or similar platforms.
Experience supporting real-time or near-real-time analytics, application telemetry, operational monitoring, product analytics, or event-driven data pipelines.
Familiarity with RESTful APIs, JSON, web scraping, event tracking, log analytics, and application-generated data.
Experience with data governance, data lineage, metadata management, data catalogs, data dictionaries, and privacy-aware data handling.
Familiarity with DevOps, CI/CD, Git workflows, Docker, infrastructure as code, Terraform, CloudFormation, or automated deployment processes.
Experience supporting AI, machine learning, computer vision, product recognition, indoor mapping, retail analytics, customer behavior analytics, or similar data-intensive environments.
Familiarity with SOC 2, CMMC Level 2, NIST SP 800-171, ISO 27001, or secure cloud operations is a plus.
5. Technical Skills
SQL and database query development.
Python scripting and data processing.
Data pipeline development and automation.
AWS cloud data services and infrastructure integration.
Data modeling, schema design, and metadata management.
ETL/ELT workflows.
API integration and data ingestion.

Data quality checks, validation logic, and pipeline monitoring.
Dashboard and analytics enablement.

Secure data handling, access control, encryption awareness, and audit support.
6. Core Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Data quality mindset.
Cloud-aware engineering judgment.
Ability to support analytics and business intelligence teams.
Strong attention to detail.
Technical documentation discipline.
Ability to troubleshoot complex data issues.
Cross-functional collaboration.
Ability to translate business needs into technical data solutions.
Adaptability in a startup or fast-changing technical environment.
Professional judgment, accountability, and ownership.
Willingness to learn new tools, technologies, and data disciplines.
7. Deliverables and Artifacts
Data pipelines and automated workflows.
Curated analytics-ready datasets.
Database tables, schemas, views, and optimized queries.
Data validation checks and quality monitoring routines.
Data source documentation and data dictionaries.
Data lineage, transformation logic, and pipeline documentation.

8. Performance Measures
Successful delivery of reliable, documented, and maintainable data pipelines.
Improved data availability, accuracy, timeliness, and usability for analytics teams.
Reduction in manual data preparation and recurring reporting effort.
Fewer dashboard errors, inconsistent metrics, and data-quality issues.

Effective collaboration with Data Analytics, AWS infrastructure, software development, and leadership teams.
Strong documentation of data sources, logic, dependencies, and assumptions.
Secure handling of company, customer, user, and product data.
Effective use of AWS resources with attention to performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
Consistent support for data-driven decision-making across the organization.
9. Working Conditions and Requirements
This role may operate in a remote, hybrid, or office-based environment depending on company needs. The Data Engineer may support multiple projects at the same time and should be comfortable working in a cross-disciplinary environment where business priorities, data sources, and technical requirements may evolve quickly.

Duration: Ongoing or semester-based with extension opportunities

Position Summary
The Mobile Game Developer designs, develops, tests, and optimizes engaging game experiences for Android and iOS. This role is responsible for building high-quality, scalable, and visually compelling gameplay features that support product goals, user satisfaction, and business success.
The ideal candidate brings strong software development skills and a passion for gameplay, user experience, animation, and interactive design. Working across product, design, art, QA, and engineering teams, this individual helps deliver polished, mobile-first experiences that perform well across devices and platforms.
This role may include work in native mobile environments and Unity-based game development, including 3D, animation, and Augmented Reality (AR) features embedded within a mobile application. The developer must be able to balance performance, usability, monetization, and long-term maintainability.
Key Responsibilities
Design, build, test, and maintain mobile game features for Android and iOS platforms. 
Develop and implement gameplay systems, player interactions, UI flows, menus, animations, transitions, and progression mechanics. 
Collaborate with product owners, designers, artists, and engineers to translate concepts, storyboards, and requirements into playable game features. 
Build scalable, reusable, and maintainable code for mobile game systems and supporting application functionality. 
Integrate visual assets, sound, animation, physics, and gameplay logic into polished mobile experiences. 
Optimize game performance for varying mobile hardware, screen sizes, memory limits, and battery usage. 
Ensure smooth gameplay and responsive interactions across a wide range of Android and iOS devices. 
Support cross-platform deployment, configuration, testing, and release activities for the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.

Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, daily standups, design reviews, and technical discussions. 
Contribute to technical documentation, gameplay specifications, architecture notes, and developer handoff materials. 
Partner with QA to reproduce, triage, and resolve functional and performance issues. 
Maintain version control discipline and follow coding standards, branching strategies, and release processes. 
Support analytics instrumentation to measure user engagement, retention, feature usage, and gameplay outcomes. 
Help implement accessibility, usability, and onboarding features that improve player experience. 
Stay current on mobile gaming trends, engine updates, SDK changes, and platform requirements. 

Mobile Game Development Focus Areas
The Mobile Game Developer may contribute across one or more of the following areas:
Gameplay Programming

UI/UX Integration

Integration of design assets into functional, performant user interfaces 
Platform Development
Native integration for Android and iOS 
Device compatibility, permissions, sensors, touch handling, haptics, and hardware-aware optimization 
Build configuration, provisioning, signing, packaging, and store submission readiness 
Performance Optimization

Responsibilities may include:

descriptions.title: AI ML Mobile Applications Developer Job Announcement
descriptions.text:
About DriverAI
DriverAI is building intelligent indoor location, navigation, computer vision, artificial intelligence, and data-driven product capabilities that help users interact with complex physical environments. Our technology supports smarter navigation, product recognition, contextual prompts, analytics, and business intelligence for retail, commercial, and other large indoor spaces.
About the Role
We are seeking an AI/ML and Mobile Applications Developer to help build mobile application features that integrate artificial intelligence, machine learning, computer vision, product recognition, cloud APIs, and data-driven services. This role supports Android and iOS application development while helping convert model outputs, backend services, and product requirements into reliable mobile experiences.
The successful candidate will work with mobile developers, AI/ML engineers, computer vision specialists, backend developers, AWS/cloud engineers, data engineers, UI/UX contributors, cybersecurity personnel, product owners, and leadership. This role is ideal for someone who can code, troubleshoot, test, document, and integrate AI-enabled capabilities into practical application features.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and maintain Android and iOS mobile application features.
Build native, cross-platform, or hybrid mobile features using technologies such as Kotlin, Swift, React Native, Flutter, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or similar tools as assigned.
Integrate AI/ML, computer vision, product recognition, visual search, personalization, recommendation, and decision-support capabilities into mobile or backend-connected workflows.
Support model input and output processing, including image preprocessing, classification labels, bounding boxes, confidence scores, embeddings, inference responses, and post-processing logic.
Connect mobile features to backend services, RESTful APIs, SDKs, authentication services, telemetry, analytics, and cloud-hosted data services.
Coordinate with AWS, backend, and data teams to validate API behavior, data contracts, logging, latency expectations, error handling, and secure integration patterns.
Test AI/ML-enabled features across different devices, operating systems, lighting conditions, camera conditions, data inputs, connectivity constraints, and real-world use cases.
Troubleshoot mobile application defects, API issues, model integration problems, latency, crashes, permissions, data-quality concerns, and user-facing defects.
Support application performance optimization for speed, responsiveness, battery impact, memory usage, network efficiency, and user experience.
Document code, features, test results, integration assumptions, model-output behavior, troubleshooting steps, and known limitations.
Participate in agile planning, standups, code reviews, demonstrations, release validation, and cross-functional technical discussions.
Perform other related technical, product, documentation, research, testing, and development duties as assigned.
Required Skills and Experience
Practical experience developing software, mobile applications, APIs, scripts, prototypes, or cloud-connected application features.
Working knowledge of Android and/or iOS development concepts, mobile application architecture, debugging, testing, and deployment practices.
Experience with at least one programming language such as Kotlin, Swift, Java, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Dart, C#, or similar.

Position Description
AI/ML and Mobile Applications Developer


1. Role Purpose (Position Summary)
The AI/ML and Mobile Applications Developer designs, develops, tests, integrates, and improves mobile application features that use artificial intelligence, machine learning, computer vision, product recognition, and data-driven services. This role bridges mobile application development and applied AI/ML implementation by helping convert trained models, APIs, data outputs, and product requirements into reliable user-facing Android and iOS capabilities.
The developer supports mobile-first software delivery for DriverAI’s intelligent indoor location, product recognition, mapping, personalization, and analytics capabilities. The role works with AI/ML engineers, computer vision specialists, backend developers, data engineers, UI/UX developers, AWS/cloud engineers, product owners, and technical leads to deliver scalable, secure, and maintainable application features.
The ideal candidate has practical software development skills, mobile application experience, strong Python or mobile coding ability, familiarity with AI/ML model integration, and the ability to work independently while following team lead direction in a fast-moving startup environment.
2. Essential Duties and Responsibilities
A. Mobile Application Development
Design, develop, test, and maintain mobile application features for Android and iOS platforms.
Develop native, cross-platform, or hybrid mobile components using Kotlin, Swift, React Native, Flutter, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar technologies as assigned.
Implement user-facing features that support indoor navigation, product recognition, contextual prompts, customer engagement, search, maps, account workflows, and analytics feedback.
Integrate mobile features with backend services, APIs, authentication services, cloud-hosted data, and AI/ML inference outputs.
Support responsive, accessible, reliable, and high-performing mobile application behavior across device types, operating system versions, and network conditions.
Debug mobile application issues involving crashes, latency, permissions, sensors, location services, API responses, model outputs, and user interface behavior.
B. AI/ML Model Integration and Applied Development
Integrate AI/ML and computer vision capabilities into mobile applications, backend-connected workflows, dashboards, prototypes, and internal tools.
Support model input and output processing, including preprocessing, post-processing, image resizing, classification labels, confidence scores, bounding boxes, embeddings, and inference responses.
Work with AI/ML engineers to test model behavior across real-world conditions, including lighting variation, device camera quality, product variation, motion, angles, latency, and environmental complexity.
Assist with implementing object detection, product recognition, visual search, recommendation, personalization, anomaly detection, and decision-support features.
Support local, cloud-based, or API-based inference workflows depending on product requirements, device constraints, privacy requirements, and performance targets.
Help evaluate model performance using accuracy, precision, recall, F1 score, confusion matrices, false positives, false negatives, latency, throughput, and user-facing reliability.
C. API, Backend, and Cloud Integration
Build and integrate RESTful APIs, SDKs, mobile backend services, and cloud-connected workflows that support mobile and AI-enabled features.

Support secure data transmission, encryption-aware workflows, least-privilege access, and privacy-conscious design when handling company, customer, user, and product data.

Create and support unit, integration, regression, functional, exploratory, usability, accessibility, and device compatibility testing for assigned features.

Troubleshoot mobile application defects, model integration errors, API failures, data inconsistencies, performance issues, and user-facing defects.
Optimize mobile application performance for speed, latency, memory usage, battery impact, network efficiency, and responsive user experience.
Support crash reporting, application logging, telemetry review, release validation, bug reproduction, and defect resolution tracking.

Document application features, model integration logic, API assumptions, test results, troubleshooting steps, data flows, and known limitations.
Participate in sprint planning, standups, backlog grooming, code reviews, architecture discussions, design reviews, demonstrations, and retrospectives.
Collaborate with product, UI/UX, mobile, backend, data, cloud, AI/ML, cybersecurity, and leadership teams to deliver production-ready solutions.
Follow approved coding standards, version control practices, branching strategies, change management expectations, and release procedures.
Perform other related technical, product, documentation, research, testing, and development duties as assigned.

4. Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have)

descriptions.title: Automation Process Developer Position Description
descriptions.text:
Position Summary
The Automation Process Developer will assess the company’s cloud-based work environment, including cloud architecture, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, remote collaboration tools, email workflows, and related business systems, to identify opportunities for automation, process improvement, and operational efficiency.
This role is responsible for designing, developing, documenting, and supporting automated workflows that streamline routine business processes, improve staff productivity, reduce manual effort, and support consistent execution across the organization. The Automation Process Developer will also support automation of email responses from web inquiries, create custom templates, and develop clear staff instructions so internal users can maintain, adapt, and expand templates and processes as business needs evolve.
The position is intended to support both technical contribution and professional growth. The company will assess the candidate’s technical, analytical, communication, and managerial capabilities and may allow the employee to expand into additional disciplines as part of a structured professional development pathway.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
Cloud, Microsoft 365, and SharePoint Process Assessment
Assess current cloud architecture, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, and remote work environments to identify manual, repetitive, or inefficient workflows.
Review existing document storage, collaboration, approval, communication, and information-sharing processes.
Evaluate how staff use Microsoft 365 tools, SharePoint sites, shared drives, email systems, Teams, and other cloud-based applications.
Identify opportunities to improve process efficiency, consistency, security, and user adoption through automation.
Recommend practical automation solutions aligned with company operations, security requirements, and business priorities.
Automation Development and Workflow Improvement

Web Inquiry and Email Response Automation

descriptions.title: Mobile Animation Design Intern  PD
descriptions.text:
Position Description: Mobile Animation & Design Intern

Position Title: Mobile Animation & Design Intern
Department: Mobile Applications
Reports To: Mobile Applications Lead & Product Owner
Employment Type: Internship (Part-Time or Full-Time)
Location: Remote
Duration: Semester-based with extension opportunities

Position Summary
The Mobile Animation & Design Intern will support the design and development of engaging, user-centered visual experiences for a mobile application. This role focuses on creating animations, motion graphics, UI visuals, and interactive elements that enhance usability, storytelling, and overall user engagement.
This position requires the ability to translate Product Owner and stakeholder vision into clear, implementable, animated concepts and UI designs that can be technically executed by development teams. The intern will help bridge creative ideation and practical implementation.
The intern must be able to design within modern mobile AR architectures, including systems where high-performance 3D engines (e.g., Unity) are embedded as modular components rather than full app shells. This includes understanding how to design experiences that load into a “Game Mode” or immersive mode only when required, keeping the primary mobile app lightweight, native, and high-performing.

Key Responsibilities
- Translate Product Owner vision, user stories, and feature requirements into animated concepts, motion flows, and visual UI designs.
- Create mobile-first UI components, including icons, buttons, onboarding screens, splash screens, logos, and in-app graphics.
- Design micro-interactions, transitions, gesture feedback, and motion effects that improve usability and engagement.
- Produce animations that are optimized for mobile performance and feasible for engineering implementation.
- Build interactive prototypes demonstrating motion, transitions, and user flows.
- Create storyboards, flow diagrams, and motion specifications for developer handoff.
- Collaborate with product managers, UX designers, and engineers to validate technical feasibility.
- Iterate designs based on user feedback, testing results, and stakeholder input.
- Maintain visual consistency with brand and design system standards.
- Support accessibility-aware motion design (reduced motion, contrast, clarity).
- Participate in sprint planning, standups, and design reviews.

Augmented Reality (AR), Virtual Reality (VR), and Game Engine Integration – Added Value Skills
Experience or strong interest in AR, VR, and real-time 3D environments is considered a major plus. The intern may support immersive and spatial design concepts related to future product features, experimental interfaces, or extended user experiences.
This role requires an understanding of modular AR architecture, where Unity or similar game engines are used as embedded libraries rather than as full-shell applications. The intern should be comfortable designing experiences that:
- Load immersive 3D environments dynamically when users enter “Game Mode” or AR mode
- Maintain continuity between native mobile UI (e.g., Kotlin/Swift) and 3D interactive environments
- Are optimized for performance, battery usage, and memory constraints
- Support seamless transitions between 2D UI and 3D immersive experiences

AR/VR-related contributions may include:
- Designing spatial UI elements and interactive overlays for AR experiences
- Creating animated 3D assets, transitions, and object interactions
- Developing onboarding flows and guidance animations for immersive environments
- Prototyping spatial interactions and motion behaviors
- Assisting with storytelling and scene composition for immersive experiences
- Applying usability principles to 3D and spatial environments

Preferred exposure areas include:
- AR frameworks: ARKit, ARCore, WebAR
- VR platforms: Meta Quest, HTC Vive, WebXR
- Game engines: Unity (strongly preferred), Unreal Engine
- 3D tools: Blender, Cinema 4D, Maya
- Understanding of spatial UX principles, depth, scale, and parallax
- Optimization of assets for performance in real-time environments

Game Development & Unity-Specific Skills (Highly Valued)
Because Unity will be used as a modular AR/3D runtime embedded within a native mobile application, experience or coursework in game development is a significant advantage.

Highly valued skills include:
- Familiarity with Unity as a library or embedded runtime
- Understanding of Unity’s rendering pipeline, scene management, and asset loading
- Experience with C# scripting in Unity
- Understanding of game loops, physics systems, animation controllers, and interaction systems
- Knowledge of shader basics and real-time lighting concepts
- Experience working with prefabs, materials, animation rigs, and state machines

Required Qualifications
- Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Graphic Design, Animation, UX/UI Design, Digital Media, Human-Computer Interaction, Game Design, or a related field
- Strong interest in mobile app design, motion design, and interactive experiences
- Ability to interpret product requirements and transform them into visual and animated concepts
- Basic understanding of UX principles, user-centered design, and usability heuristics
- Strong visual storytelling skills
- Comfort collaborating with engineers and product owners

Preferred Skills
- Experience with design and animation tools such as:
  - Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch
  - After Effects, Lottie, Rive, Principle, Framer, or similar
  - Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop
- Familiarity with mobile UI frameworks and guidelines (Apple Human Interface Guidelines, Google Material Design)
- Understanding of motion design principles (timing, easing, continuity, feedback)
- Experience preparing developer handoff artifacts (redlines, specs, tokens, animation exports)
- Exposure to JSON/Lottie workflows or real-time animation frameworks
- Basic knowledge of front-end or mobile development concepts (Swift, Kotlin, React Native, Flutter, or similar)
- Familiarity with 3D design, spatial interfaces, or immersive media
- Basic familiarity with Unity and C# (strong plus)
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- Ability to accept feedback and iterate quickly

Core Competencies
- Visual communication
- Motion storytelling
- Product thinking
- Collaboration
- Attention to detail
- Time management
- Problem-solving
- Creative experimentation
- Technical curiosity

Learning Outcomes
By the end of this internship, the intern will:
- Gain hands-on experience designing and animating real-world mobile products
- Learn how to translate business and product vision into production-ready designs
- Understand the full lifecycle of mobile UI and motion design
- Gain exposure to modular AR architectures and embedded 3D engines
- Collaborate within an agile product environment
- Build a professional portfolio of shipped or production-level work

Deliverables
- Mobile UI screens and components
- Animated micro-interactions and transitions
- Onboarding and walkthrough animations
- Interactive prototypes
- Motion and UI style guidelines
- Developer handoff documentation
- (Optional) AR/VR concept mockups or spatial interaction demos

Work Environment
- Collaborative, cross-functional product team
- Agile sprint cycles
- Emphasis on creativity, experimentation, and iteration
- Mentorship from senior designers, game developers, and product leaders

Strong written and verbal communication skills, including ability to communicate with executives, technical teams, and non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to manage development priorities, coordinate team progress, identify blockers, escalate risks, and support continuous improvement in an agile environment.
Portfolio, Git repository, app samples, school projects, internship projects, app store links, or demonstrations showing mobile development capability.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience leading or coordinating a small development team, intern group, agile sprint team, or cross-functional technical effort.
Experience building or contributing to published Android or iOS applications.
Experience supporting both Android and iOS, or demonstrated ability to support one platform while learning the other.
Experience with React Native, Flutter, Kotlin Multiplatform, Firebase, AWS Amplify, AppSync, or comparable mobile/cloud technologies.

Tools and Technology Areas

DriverAI Mobile Applications Division
Position Overview
The Mobile Application Lead Developer leads mobile application development for DriverAI by guiding assigned developers, coordinating technical progress, and supporting hands-on Android and iOS development. This role converts executive and product priorities into clear agile tasks, communicates progress, risks, and blockers to leadership and team members, and promotes secure, reliable, well-documented, and continuously improving mobile application delivery.
About the Opportunity
DriverAI is seeking a Mobile Application Lead Developer to lead and support the development of Android and iOS applications that enable intelligent indoor location, navigation, product interaction, contextual prompts, AI-enabled features, and data-driven user experiences.
This role is suited for a hands-on developer who can provide direction to a small team, guide technical progress, communicate clearly with executives and team members, and help build a progressive agile environment focused on continuous improvement.
Role Summary
The Mobile Application Lead Developer will manage day-to-day technical progress for assigned mobile development work while remaining actively involved in coding, API integration, testing, debugging, documentation, and release support. The successful candidate will translate product and executive priorities into clear development tasks, guide team members through implementation, identify blockers, communicate status and risks, and help strengthen mobile development practices over time.
Summary of Duties
Lead Android and iOS mobile application development using native or approved cross-platform technologies.
Provide technical direction, mentoring, code review feedback, and implementation guidance to developers, interns, and contributors.
Manage development progress by translating product and executive priorities into sprint tasks, milestones, technical assignments, and release objectives.
Communicate technical progress, risks, blockers, tradeoffs, and release readiness to executives, team members, and stakeholders.
Support hands-on development, API integration, testing, troubleshooting, analytics instrumentation, secure coding, and app release activities.
Promote agile delivery, continuous improvement, reusable standards, documentation discipline, and strong collaboration across teams.
Perform other related development, technical leadership, testing, documentation, product support, and operational duties as assigned.

Leadership and Team Direction
Lead assigned mobile application development efforts for Android and iOS platforms.
Define technical tasks, assign work, clarify expectations, review implementation approaches, and support practical problem resolution.
Guide developers and contributors through coding standards, architecture decisions, testing expectations, documentation requirements, and release preparation.
Mentor team members and support professional growth through constructive feedback, technical explanation, and hands-on examples.
Identify blockers, dependencies, risks, and resource needs and escalate concerns with recommended solutions.
Development and Technical Progress
Design, develop, test, and maintain mobile application features using Kotlin, Java, Swift, SwiftUI, React Native, Flutter, Kotlin Multiplatform, or other approved technologies as assigned.
Translate product requirements, user stories, wireframes, prototypes, and UI/UX designs into working mobile features and team deliverables.
Build clean, modular, testable, maintainable, documented, and secure code using approved development practices and version-control workflows.
Review pull requests, implementation notes, architecture decisions, technical debt, and defect trends to improve product quality and development consistency.
Support DriverAI capabilities such as indoor navigation, location-aware experiences, computer vision outputs, AI-enabled workflows, product recognition, contextual prompts, and real-time data feedback.
Agile Delivery and Continuous Improvement
Coordinate agile activities such as sprint planning, backlog refinement, standups, code reviews, demonstrations, retrospectives, and release planning.
Maintain visibility into sprint commitments, task progress, dependencies, blockers, test readiness, and release status.
Use lessons learned, sprint outcomes, release findings, defect patterns, and team feedback to improve development practices.
Promote a progressive work environment that values iteration, collaboration, accountability, process improvement, and practical innovation.

Position Description: Mobile Application Lead Developer
Leadership, Development Direction, Technical Progress, Agile Delivery, and Continuous Improvement

1. Role Purpose / Position Summary
The Mobile Application Lead Developer leads the planning, technical direction, development, testing, release support, and continuous improvement of DriverAI Android and iOS mobile applications. This role is responsible for guiding the mobile development team, translating product and executive priorities into actionable technical work, and ensuring mobile application progress is clearly communicated, tracked, and aligned with business objectives.
The Lead Developer remains hands-on while providing direction to developers, interns, and technical contributors. The role supports native and/or approved cross-platform mobile development, API integration, cloud-connected features, authentication, analytics, location-aware workflows, computer vision or artificial intelligence outputs, product recognition capabilities, and production release readiness.
This position requires strong technical judgment, team coordination, agile delivery discipline, clear communication with executives and team members, and a continuous improvement mindset. The successful candidate can lead technical progress in a fast-moving startup environment while maintaining secure, reliable, maintainable, and user-friendly mobile applications.
2. Essential Duties and Responsibilities
A. Technical Leadership and Development Direction
Lead assigned mobile application development activities across Android, iOS, and approved cross-platform technologies.
Provide technical direction, task guidance, code-level feedback, and development priorities for assigned developers, interns, and contributors.
Translate executive, product, and business priorities into clear technical objectives, development milestones, sprint tasks, and measurable deliverables.
Guide architecture decisions, coding standards, component design, application structure, API integration patterns, and release-readiness practices.
Review technical progress, identify blockers, escalate risks, and recommend practical solutions to maintain forward momentum.
Mentor team members on mobile development practices, debugging, testing, documentation, secure coding, and professional technical communication.
B. Android and iOS Application Development
Design, develop, test, and maintain mobile application features for Android and iOS platforms.
Develop or guide native Android features using Kotlin or Java and Android Studio, and native iOS features using Swift, SwiftUI, and Xcode when assigned.
Support or evaluate cross-platform development using React Native, Flutter, Kotlin Multiplatform, or similar frameworks when selected by the technical team.
Build and direct development of clean, modular, maintainable, documented, and reusable mobile code aligned with approved architecture and release requirements.
Implement responsive and accessible mobile user interfaces aligned with Apple Human Interface Guidelines, Google Material Design, and approved DriverAI UI/UX designs.
Support app lifecycle functions such as onboarding, authentication, permissions, notifications, profiles, search, product discovery, mapping, contextual prompts, and user workflows.
C. Agile Delivery, Team Coordination, and Progress Management
Lead or actively support agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, standups, demonstrations, retrospectives, and release planning.
Break down complex technical objectives into manageable user stories, engineering tasks, acceptance criteria, and implementation plans.
Coordinate daily or recurring technical progress with team members and maintain visibility into task status, dependencies, risks, and blockers.
Promote a progressive agile environment that values iteration, accountability, collaboration, practical experimentation, and continuous improvement.
Support team prioritization based on product value, technical risk, security needs, release timelines, customer impact, and executive direction.
Maintain organized repositories, branches, pull requests, issue tickets, release notes, architecture notes, decision records, and technical documentation.
D. Executive, Product, and Cross-Functional Communication
Communicate technical progress, risks, assumptions, tradeoffs, resource needs, release readiness, and recommended actions to executives and leadership.
Provide concise status updates that help leadership understand development progress, technical decisions, blockers, and product readiness.
Collaborate with product managers, UI/UX designers, backend engineers, cloud engineers, AI/ML contributors, computer vision teams, cybersecurity personnel, quality assurance, and business stakeholders.
Translate technical issues into clear business-impact language for non-technical stakeholders while preserving sufficient technical detail for engineering teams.
Support technical demonstrations, roadmap discussions, sprint reviews, product evaluations, and executive decision briefings as needed.
E. API, Cloud, Data, and Product Integration
Lead mobile integration with backend services, RESTful APIs, GraphQL APIs, cloud services, databases, authentication providers, analytics tools, and third-party software development kits.
Ensure secure data exchange using approved authentication, authorization, encryption, token management, and session handling practices.
Work with backend and cloud engineers to validate data contracts, error handling, API latency, synchronization, offline behavior, and user-facing data quality.
Guide mobile integration of DriverAI capabilities such as indoor navigation, location-aware experiences, computer vision outputs, artificial intelligence workflows, product recognition, contextual prompts, and user feedback loops.
Support telemetry, analytics, crash reporting, performance monitoring, feature adoption measurement, and data-driven product improvement.
F. Mobile Quality Assurance, Testing, and Release Support
Establish and guide mobile testing practices for unit, integration, regression, usability, accessibility, cross-device, and release-readiness validation.
Review, reproduce, prioritize, document, and resolve defects, crashes, performance issues, API errors, permissions problems, and platform-specific issues.
Use mobile debugging, profiling, logging, and crash reporting tools to improve stability, performance, memory usage, battery efficiency, and user experience.
Coordinate build configuration, signing, provisioning, TestFlight, Google Play Console, internal testing tracks, versioning, release notes, and app store submission readiness.
Support release planning, release validation, post-release monitoring, rollback coordination, corrective action, and lessons-learned reviews.
G. Security, Privacy, Compliance, and Technical Controls
Guide secure mobile development practices, including input validation, secure storage, least-privilege permissions, protected API access, data minimization, and privacy-by-design principles.
Protect company intellectual property, customer information, user data, credentials, tokens, source code, product designs, and internal documentation.
Support implementation of mobile security controls such as certificate pinning, secure key storage, encrypted local storage, multi-factor authentication flows, and approved identity integrations when required.
Coordinate with cybersecurity and cloud teams to support security reviews, privacy reviews, SOC 2, CMMC, NIST-aligned controls, or customer due diligence when applicable.
Escalate suspected vulnerabilities, privacy concerns, security risks, unauthorized access concerns, or release risks to appropriate leadership and security personnel.
H. Continuous Improvement and Other Duties
Identify opportunities to improve development processes, code quality, documentation, build reliability, release readiness, collaboration, and team productivity.
Promote reusable templates, coding patterns, checklists, lessons learned, runbooks, and standards that improve team execution over time.
Support technical research, tool evaluation, automation, documentation, prototype development, and process improvements based on business priorities.
Perform other related development, technical leadership, testing, documentation, product support, and operational duties as assigned.
3. Minimum Qualifications / Required Skills
Bachelor’s degree, certificate, bootcamp completion, current enrollment with strong experience, or equivalent practical experience in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Mobile Development, or a related technical field.
Hands-on experience developing Android and/or iOS applications through professional work, internships, academic projects, portfolio projects, or comparable practical experience.
Working knowledge of Kotlin or Java for Android and/or Swift or SwiftUI for iOS; strong cross-platform experience may be considered when supported by mobile fundamentals.
Experience providing technical guidance, task direction, code review feedback, mentoring, or informal team leadership.
Understanding of mobile application architecture, state management, navigation, permissions, lifecycle events, data persistence, responsive layouts, and platform-specific constraints.
Experience integrating APIs, JSON data, authentication flows, cloud-hosted services, analytics, or third-party SDKs into mobile applications.
Familiarity with Git-based version control, issue tracking, code reviews, testing, debugging, release support, and software development lifecycle practices.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including ability to communicate clearly with executives, technical teams, and non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to lead assigned tasks, manage priorities, coordinate team progress, communicate blockers, and support continuous improvement in an agile environment.
Portfolio, GitHub/GitLab repository, app samples, school projects, internship work, app store links, or demonstrations showing relevant mobile development capability.
4. Required Technical Skill Areas

5. Preferred Qualifications / Desired Skills
Experience leading or coordinating a small development team, intern group, sprint team, or cross-functional technical effort.
Experience building or contributing to published Android or iOS applications.
Experience with both Android and iOS development, or demonstrated ability to support one platform while learning the other.
Experience with React Native, Flutter, Kotlin Multiplatform, Firebase, AWS Amplify, AppSync, or comparable mobile/cloud development frameworks.
Experience with AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, serverless services, mobile backend services, cloud storage, push notifications, or authentication platforms.
Familiarity with CI/CD for mobile builds, automated tests, build pipelines, Fastlane, GitHub Actions, Bitrise, Codemagic, or comparable tools.
Experience with mobile analytics, event tracking, funnels, crash reporting, remote configuration, feature flags, or A/B testing.
Experience integrating maps, indoor positioning, GPS alternatives, Bluetooth, sensors, camera functions, augmented reality, computer vision outputs, or product recognition features.
Familiarity with AI-enabled applications, computer vision workflows, product recognition, real-time feedback loops, or data-driven mobile features.
Understanding of SOC 2, CMMC, NIST, privacy requirements, secure SDLC, mobile application security testing, or OWASP Mobile Application Security concepts.
6. Core Competencies
Technical leadership and team direction.
Mobile-first software engineering mindset.
Agile execution and continuous improvement.
Clear executive and team communication.
Problem-solving, debugging, and technical curiosity.
Ability to translate product requirements into working mobile features and team deliverables.
Attention to detail in code, testing, documentation, user experience, and release readiness.
Strong collaboration across product, design, engineering, cloud, security, and leadership teams.
Adaptability in a fast-changing startup environment.
Commitment to secure, ethical, privacy-aware, and maintainable software development.
Ownership, accountability, mentoring, and professional judgment.
7. Deliverables and Artifacts
Mobile application features, components, screens, modules, and bug fixes.
Development plans, sprint task breakdowns, technical direction notes, team assignments, and progress updates.
Android and/or iOS builds ready for internal testing, demonstration, release review, or store submission support.
API integration code, SDK integrations, event tracking, telemetry, and mobile data workflows.

Team members receive clear direction, timely feedback, and practical support to maintain development progress.

Executives and stakeholders receive clear, useful communication on technical progress, risks, tradeoffs, and release readiness.
The Lead Developer contributes to agile execution, continuous improvement, documentation quality, and overall product maturity.

This role may operate remotely, hybrid, or at a company-designated location depending on business needs. descriptions.title: SIN3 3D CV Position
descriptions.text:
Role Summary
The SIN3 Engineer is responsible for building end-to-end 3D computer vision and AI pipelines that convert raw video/image input into high-quality 3D meshes and visual data products. This role covers model design, training, deployment, data preprocessing, 3D reconstruction, video processing, and performance optimization on GPU hardware. The engineer collaborates closely with other AI, platform, and product teams to deliver real-time or near-real-time CV capabilities into production systems.
Key Responsibilities
1. Design & Train CV / 3D Models
Design, train, and iterate on models for object detection, tracking, depth estimation, pose estimation, and 3D reconstruction from images and video.
Build 3D meshing pipelines (e.g., multi-view stereo, SfM, NeRF-style methods, point-cloud to mesh workflows) that produce usable meshes with geometric continuity and visual quality.
Maintain versioned, reproducible experiments (code, configs, datasets) and report metrics and failure modes clearly.
2. Video & Visual Data Preprocessing
Build repeatable pipelines for video preprocessing: frame extraction, resolution/format conversion, stabilization, denoising, cropping, temporal sampling, and optical-flow–based tracking.
Implement image/sequence augmentation strategies (geometric, photometric, temporal) to improve model robustness.
Manage large image/video datasets with metadata, labeling, and data-quality checks, including handling of corrupted, misaligned, or mis-labeled samples.
3. 3D Meshing & Spatial Data Products
Generate, refine, and validate 3D meshes, point clouds, and surface reconstructions suitable for downstream use (analytics, visualization, simulation, or AR/VR).
Use tools/libraries such as Open3D, PyTorch3D, COLMAP, MeshLab, Blender, Unity/Unreal (as applicable) to process, visualize, and debug 3D outputs.
Ensure 3D outputs meet specs for scale, alignment, topology quality, and continuity required by product teams.
4. Deployment & Real-Time Inference
Package models for deployment using ONNX/TorchScript or similar, and integrate them into real-time or batch inference services.
Meet target latency, FPS/throughput, and hardware constraints (GPU/CPU, edge vs. cloud), documenting deployment procedures and rollback paths.
Collaborate with backend, mobile, and infra engineers to expose models via APIs, microservices, or SDKs and validate end-to-end behavior in the application.
5. Experiments, Benchmarks & Optimization
Run hypothesis-driven experiments with clear baselines, controlled changes, and documented configs and metrics.
Perform inference optimization (quantization, pruning, batching, mixed precision, caching) and profile performance to improve speed and stability while preserving accuracy.
Monitor model drift and degradation in production, propose retraining/retuning strategies, and track improvements with before/after benchmarks.
6. Debugging & Collaboration
Systematically triage issues across data, model, pipeline, and deployment layers, using logs, visualizations, and metrics to identify root causes.
Maintain concise technical documentation, experiment logs, and troubleshooting notes, and keep GitHub issue boards and PRs clean and traceable.
Collaborate effectively with other SIN tracks (e.g., SIN2 AI/ML), product, and domain experts, communicating status, risks, and tradeoffs clearly.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Strong proficiency in Python and modern deep learning frameworks (PyTorch preferred; TensorFlow acceptable).
Hands-on experience with computer vision:
Detection/tracking (e.g., YOLO, Faster R-CNN, DeepSORT/ByteTrack)
3D / geometric CV (SfM, depth estimation, pose estimation, multi-view geometry)
Experience with 3D data and meshing: point clouds, mesh reconstruction, cleanup, and optimization (Open3D, PyTorch3D, COLMAP, MeshLab, or similar).
Experience building end-to-end pipelines for image/video data (OpenCV, ffmpeg, dataset loaders, augmentation, and data versioning).
Familiarity with GPU training and inference (NVIDIA stack, CUDA basics, mixed-precision training, profiling).
Ability to run metrics-driven experiments: define evaluation protocols, analyze error cases, and make actionable recommendations.
Solid Git/GitHub workflow experience (branches, PRs, code reviews, CI basics).
Preferred / “Nice to Have”
Experience with NeRF, implicit representations, or neural rendering for 3D reconstruction.
Familiarity with SLAM / visual odometry / multi-session registration for spatial mapping.
Experience with MLOps tooling: experiment tracking (Weights & Biases, MLflow), data versioning (DVC), or pipeline orchestration (Airflow, Prefect).
Exposure to cloud environments (AWS preferred) for GPU training, data storage, and deployment (e.g., S3, EC2, ECR, ECS/EKS).
Experience integrating 3D assets into game engines or real-time visualization frameworks (Unity, Unreal, or WebGL-based tools).
Prior work in retail, robotics, mapping, or AR/VR applications is a plus.
Alignment with Evaluation Criteria
These responsibilities and skills line up directly with your existing Measurement & Evaluation Requirements (design/train models, deploy in real-time, manage visual datasets, run experiments, optimize inference, debug & collaborate) and simply make the expectations around 3D, video preprocessing, and meshing explicit for candidates and internal reviewers.

descriptions.text:
UI/UX Designer (Application UI)

1. Role Purpose (Position Summary)
The UI/UX Designer (Application UI) owns the user experience and visual design for our mobile and web applications. This role turns product and business requirements into clear, simple, and accessible interfaces and works closely with Engineering to make sure designs are built correctly. The designer understands responsive layouts, component states, accessibility, and how all of this fits into a design system.
2. Essential Duties and Responsibilities
A. UX Discovery and Experience Design
Leads designs for assigned mobile and web features from discovery through launch.
Turn requirements into user journeys, task flows, information architecture, wireframes, prototypes, and final UI.
Work with Product to clarify problems, user needs, and success measures.
Run or support user research (interviews, surveys, usability tests) and use findings to improve designs.
B. UI Design and Application UI Delivery
Create high-fidelity designs that follow brand and design system standards.
Define interaction patterns and behaviors that support usability, accessibility, and performance.
Document key UI states and edge cases (e.g., loading, empty, error, permissions, breakpoints).
Provide clear specs for Engineering (annotations, naming, reusable components).
C. Design-to-Implementation Collaboration (Application UI)
Work with engineers to confirm feasibility and accurate implementation of designs.
Provide high-quality handoff files, including component behavior and layout rules.
Join implementation reviews, UI QA, and release checks to confirm design fidelity and usability.
Help identify and fix UX/UI issues after launch through planned iterations.
D. Design System Stewardship
Build and maintain the design system (components, patterns, typography, spacing, tokens, accessibility rules).
Promote reusable patterns and standards to keep mobile and web experiences consistent.
Take part in design critiques and keep related documentation up to date.
E. Measurement and Continuous Improvement
Run UX audits and recommend improvements using usability feedback, analytics, and support data.
Work with Product and Engineering to define UX KPIs (e.g., task completion, activation, conversion, retention).
Support experiments and iterations that improve user outcomes and reduce friction.
3. Minimum Qualifications (Required)
2+ years designing digital products (mobile and web preferred).
Strong portfolio showing UX process and high-quality UI design.
Proficiency with Figma (preferred) or similar tools (Sketch, Adobe XD), including components and prototyping.
Solid understanding of information architecture, interaction design, visual hierarchy, and usability.
Working knowledge of accessibility and inclusive design (contrast, focus states, touch targets; basic WCAG awareness).
Experience working with Product and Engineering in agile teams; strong written and verbal communication.

Experience creating or growing design systems and component libraries.
Familiarity with design tokens, variants, theming, and responsive layout rules.

Familiarity with Apple Human Interface Guidelines and Material Design.
C. Technical Fluency (Not Required)
Exposure to React/TypeScript and component-based UI workflows.
Familiarity with Kotlin (Android) and/or Swift (iOS) UI patterns and constraints.
Awareness of modern UI frameworks such as Jetpack Compose, SwiftUI, React Native, or Flutter.
D. Data-Informed UX
Experience using analytics and/or experiments (funnels, event tracking, A/B tests) to guide UX decisions.
5. Core Competencies
User-centered problem solving and empathy
Strong visual design and interaction skills
Ability to work through ambiguity in a structured way
Clear communication and stakeholder management
Cross-functional collaboration
High attention to detail and quality
Openness to feedback and iteration
Ability to manage time across multiple projects
6. Deliverables and Artifacts
User journeys, flows, and information architecture
Wireframes and clickable prototypes
High-fidelity UI screens with annotations/specifications
Component documentation (states, variants, responsive rules)
Accessibility notes and UX audit findings
Design system updates and documentation
Implementation review notes and UI QA findings
7. Performance Measures (How Success is Evaluated)
Design quality: clear, consistent, usable, and accessible UI across products.
Implementation fidelity: shipped UI closely matches design; minimal rework.
Speed and scalability: faster delivery through reusable patterns and a strong design system.
User outcomes: better task completion, less friction, and improved conversion/retention where relevant.
Collaboration: strong partnership with Product and Engineering and reliable documentation.
8. Working Conditions and Requirements
Extended periods working at a computer and in digital collaboration tools.
Participation in agile ceremonies (planning, standups, reviews).
Occasional meetings outside core hours for distributed teams, as needed.

descriptions.title: Website Developer Lead Developer Full Stack Position Description
descriptions.text:
1. Position Summary
The Website Developer Lead Developer / Full Stack leads the planning, design, development, testing, deployment, and continuous improvement of DriverAI web applications and website platforms while remaining hands-on as a full stack developer. This role combines technical leadership with direct contribution across responsive front-end development, back-end services, APIs, databases, cloud-hosted environments, security practices, analytics, and integration with AI-enabled DriverAI product capabilities.
The position is responsible for translating business, product, customer, and executive priorities into maintainable web solutions, sprint tasks, technical designs, and working software. The Website Developer Lead guides assigned developers, interns, contractors, or contributors; supports code quality and delivery discipline; and ensures that website and web application work is secure, scalable, documented, accessible, and aligned with DriverAI’s product roadmap.
2. Leadership and Accountability
Lead assigned website, web application, and full stack development activities from requirements through release and post-launch improvement.
Translate product goals, business priorities, and leadership direction into technical plans, sprint tasks, development milestones, and measurable deliverables.
Provide day-to-day technical guidance to web developers, interns, contractors, and cross-functional contributors as assigned.
Review work for quality, maintainability, usability, security, accessibility, and alignment with approved architecture and design standards.
Communicate progress, risks, blockers, dependencies, and resource needs to the CTO, Product Lead, and relevant stakeholders.
Support planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, retrospectives, technical documentation, and developer handoffs.
Promote professional development, mentoring, knowledge sharing, coding standards, and continuous improvement across the web development team.
3. Essential Duties and Responsibilities
A. Website and Front-End Development
Design, build, test, and maintain responsive, mobile-friendly websites and web applications using modern front-end frameworks and component-based development practices.
Develop user-facing features using technologies such as React, Next.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and related frameworks or tools as assigned.
Implement approved UI/UX designs, wireframes, prototypes, and design system components with attention to usability, accessibility, responsiveness, and performance.
Create reusable components, page templates, navigation structures, forms, dashboards, landing pages, and application interfaces that support DriverAI product and business needs.
Support website content structure, technical SEO readiness, page performance, metadata, routing, and maintainable information architecture in coordination with product and marketing stakeholders.
B. Full Stack Development and Back-End Services
Develop back-end services, APIs, application logic, authentication flows, and integration layers that support web, mobile, AI-enabled, and internal business applications.
Build and maintain RESTful or similar APIs using Node.js, Python/FastAPI, Java, .NET, or comparable technologies based on project requirements.
Integrate web applications with databases, cloud services, third-party APIs, analytics platforms, authentication providers, mapping/location services, and internal DriverAI systems.
Support data flows between front-end applications, back-end services, mobile-connected platforms, AI/CV outputs, dashboards, and operational tools.
Write clean, modular, testable, documented, and maintainable code that supports scalability, reliability, and future team development.
C. AI-Enabled, Computer Vision, and Data-Driven Application Support
Support web interfaces and back-end integrations that display, manage, or consume AI-enabled features, computer vision outputs, product recognition data, indoor mapping information, analytics, or real-time feedback signals.
Collaborate with AI/ML, computer vision, mobile, database, and cloud teams to integrate model outputs, structured data, event streams, visual results, and operational insights into usable web experiences.
Build internal tools, dashboards, labeling support interfaces, quality review screens, testing utilities, and reporting views that help teams evaluate AI/CV performance and product readiness.
Support practical use of AI tools to improve development productivity, documentation, testing, code review, analysis, and workflow automation while protecting company data and intellectual property.
D. Cloud, DevOps, Deployment, and Environment Support
Support web application hosting, configuration, deployment, monitoring, and troubleshooting in AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, or other approved environments.
Assist with CI/CD pipelines, build processes, release workflows, environment variables, secrets handling, branch strategies, deployment approvals, and rollback planning.
Use Git/GitHub or comparable version control practices, including branching, pull requests, reviews, commit discipline, and issue tracking.
Collaborate with cloud and security teams to ensure development, staging, and production environments are properly separated, monitored, and controlled.
Support containerized, serverless, or traditional deployment models using tools such as Docker, cloud functions, managed databases, static hosting, or application services as applicable.
E. Security, Privacy, and Compliance Support
Follow secure coding practices, least-privilege access, authentication and authorization controls, input validation, error handling, encryption, and data protection requirements.
Coordinate with cybersecurity and cloud personnel to support SOC 2, CMMC, NIST, contractual, privacy, and internal governance requirements where applicable.
Assist with security reviews, vulnerability remediation, dependency updates, access control checks, logging, monitoring, and evidence collection for web and application systems.
Protect confidential company information, customer information, source code, designs, credentials, datasets, and intellectual property.
Escalate technical, security, privacy, operational, or compliance concerns to leadership promptly.
F. Testing, Quality Assurance, and Performance Optimization
Develop and support unit, integration, regression, end-to-end, usability, accessibility, cross-browser, and cross-device testing for assigned features.
Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve front-end, back-end, API, database, cloud, authentication, integration, and performance issues.
Monitor and improve page load performance, responsiveness, latency, reliability, uptime, scalability, error rates, and user-facing quality.
Use logs, metrics, profiling tools, user feedback, analytics, and issue reports to identify root causes and implement corrective actions.
Support release readiness reviews, production validation, defect tracking, and post-launch improvement cycles.
G. Collaboration, Documentation, and Other Duties
Collaborate with product owners, UI/UX designers, mobile developers, AI/ML engineers, data analysts, cloud engineers, cybersecurity personnel, marketing, operations, and company leadership.
Prepare and maintain technical documentation, architecture notes, API documentation, developer guides, implementation notes, test results, release notes, and support procedures.
Participate in agile ceremonies, technical reviews, architecture discussions, sprint planning, standups, demos, retrospectives, and stakeholder briefings.
Research, evaluate, and recommend tools, frameworks, libraries, and process improvements that improve delivery quality and development efficiency.
Perform other related duties as assigned to support DriverAI’s evolving website, software, AI-enabled product, cloud, and business technology needs.
4. Required Qualifications
Experience developing full stack web applications or equivalent academic, internship, project, or professional experience.
Proficiency with front-end technologies such as JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, React, Next.js, Angular, Vue, or similar frameworks.
Experience with back-end technologies such as Node.js, Python/FastAPI, Java, .NET, or similar application frameworks.
Experience developing, consuming, or documenting APIs and integrating third-party services.
Working knowledge of relational or NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB, or similar systems.
Familiarity with Git/GitHub, CI/CD concepts, cloud hosting, debugging, testing, and deployment workflows.
Understanding of authentication, authorization, secure coding, data protection, and basic web application security practices.
Ability to organize tasks, communicate clearly, document work, and collaborate across technical and non-technical teams.
For lead-level assignment: ability to guide other contributors, review work, manage technical priorities, and communicate risks and blockers to leadership.
5. Preferred Qualifications
Experience leading small development teams, interns, contractors, or project contributors.
Experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud services and cloud-hosted application deployment.
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, serverless services, infrastructure-as-code, or automated deployments.
Familiarity with AI-enabled applications, computer vision platforms, product recognition systems, mapping/location services, or data-driven products.
Experience supporting APIs or web services for Android, iOS, or mobile-connected platforms.
Experience with analytics instrumentation, dashboards, event tracking, real-time data feedback loops, or product usage reporting.
Knowledge of accessibility, responsive design, performance optimization, SEO foundations, privacy-by-design, and secure development practices.
Experience in startup, agile, product development, research, or cross-disciplinary engineering environments.
6. Core Competencies
Technical leadership and ownership
Full stack engineering judgment
Hands-on coding and troubleshooting
Clear communication and documentation
Cross-functional collaboration
Security- and privacy-aware development
User-centered product thinking
Performance and quality orientation
Adaptability in a fast-moving startup environment
Mentoring and team support
7. Deliverables and Performance Expectations
Stable, maintainable, and secure website and web application features.
Responsive front-end interfaces and reusable components aligned with approved designs.
Reliable back-end services, APIs, integrations, and database-connected features.
Documented code, architecture notes, API notes, testing results, and release materials.
Clear sprint progress updates, task tracking, risk identification, and blocker escalation.
Timely code reviews, developer guidance, and quality improvements for assigned contributors.
Improved performance, reliability, accessibility, security, and user experience over time.
Support for AI-enabled, data-driven, and mobile-connected DriverAI product capabilities as assigned.
8. Work Environment
This role may operate in a remote, hybrid, or office-based environment depending on company needs. The Website Developer Lead Developer / Full Stack may support multiple projects simultaneously and should be comfortable working in a cross-disciplinary startup environment where priorities may evolve based on product, customer, technical, security, or operational requirements.
